notes: No genuine New Arrivals-type PLP found on goodearth.in. Access: direct HTTP fetch (no WAF, robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow); confirmed with Playwright rendering. Checked: (1) sitemap.xml -> sitemap-header.xml and sitemap-footer.xml -> no New Arrivals/New In/Just In/Latest/What's New/New Collection URL anywhere. (2) Rendered /sitemap page (full site index, 138 links) -> same, no such entry. (3) Rendered homepage (scrolled fully) -> the only 'new' wording is the promo banner 'Explore the new apparel collection - Saanjh', which links to https://www.goodearth.in/catalogue/category/women/saanjh_576/ - this is Good Earth's regular Saanjh apparel product line (a named collection/category, already covered as a normal category taxonomy node, out of this project's home-decor scope anyway since it's apparel) and reads as an editorial teaser for a themed apparel line, not a 'recently added to catalogue' New Arrivals listing (no date-based sorting, no 'new' badge grid, it's the same Saanjh subcategory PLP seen in the taxonomy facets). Not recorded as New Arrivals per the brief's 'Collection pages need inspection' rule - this is a themed product line, not a genuine newest-additions listing, and it is apparel (out of scope) regardless. (4) Guessed URL shapes /new-arrivals, /new-in, /whats-new, /new-collection rendered via Playwright: all fall through to the SPA's default homepage content (identical to the deliberately nonexistent control URL /nonexistent-random-xyz123), proving these are not real routes. (5) Site's own product-search API was tested with 'new arrivals' query terms - the search param is silently ignored and always returns the full catalog count (884), confirmed against a nonsense control query returning the identical count; not relied on as absence proof. (6) Pulled the complete categoryShop taxonomy facet list from the search API (18 real nodes, listed in the Bestsellers file's notes) - none represents a New Arrivals merchandising concept. Concluded: no New Arrivals PLP exists on this site.
